mechanism: Both agents have endocrine effects on estrogen/progesterone pathways; medroxyprogesterone may antagonize the therapeutic efficacy of anastrozole in hormone-responsive breast cancer by competing for progesterone receptor signaling and potentially affecting estrogen suppression.
action: Avoid concurrent use in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer treatment; if both agents are clinically necessary, monitor for reduced anastrozole efficacy and consider alternative progestin formulations or timing separation.
